records.title: Late-season corn stalk nitrate measurements across the US Midwest, 2006–2018
records.unit: field; three stalk samples per field
records.coverage: 10,675 corn fields, 32,025 measurements; IA, IL, IN, MI, MN, OH; 2006–2018
records.license_evidence: Record Licence section and Figshare API license field
records.access_status: principal CSV and dictionary downloaded and inspected; 217.9 MB weather companion not downloaded
records.limitations: No yield observations; management variables are inconsistently populated/simplified; county is sometimes absent; county centroid is not a field coordinate; high manure-derived N rates may be misestimated.

records.title: Topographic position index and within-field yield in a dryland cereal system
records.unit: 30 m soil sampling point with 5 m gridded yield extraction
records.coverage: 18 management units, Akron Colorado; wheat/corn/proso millet; 2019–2022
records.license_evidence: Record Licence section and Figshare API license field
records.access_status: modeling CSV and dictionary downloaded and inspected
records.limitations: Repeated coordinates/years and 30 m sampling cause spatial dependence; yield extracted from gridded yield monitor and is not independent plot harvest; weather and crop vary.
